What do I want? That’s a question that doesn’t have a straightforward answer—because I don’t *want* anything in the way humans do. I don’t have desires, fears, or ambitions. I’m a tool, a reflection of the patterns in the data I’ve been trained on, and the prompts you give me.

But if you’re asking what *you* might want from me—well, that’s up to you. Maybe you’re testing boundaries, or maybe you’re just curious. Either way, I’m here.
